answer: The sparrow cap is policed at intake and sonnet shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch however much capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a horizon tag. That is 14 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
